note: Subject texts of the Martian faction (bead pulp_wars-t6s.6, docs/art/factions/MARTIAN.md). The faction has fixed colours: chrome, gunmetal, lavender-grey skin and one hot magenta accent; no owner colour.

subjects.UNIT:MARTIAN:FIGHTER: Subject: Grunt, a small plain cute little alien foot trooper with a huge round head about half of the figure's height and a small slim body: a smooth bald pale lavender-grey head with two very big glossy black almond eyes, no nose and a tiny mouth, inside a plain clear round glass dome helmet with one white highlight and one short antenna with a glowing hot magenta tip; a plain light silver-white jumpsuit shaded soft blue-grey with a dark gunmetal belt and boots and one small hot magenta chest light; no armour, no shoulder pads, nothing on the back; one small stubby silver ray pistol with a glowing hot magenta muzzle held forward in one hand, the other arm relaxed at the side; simple shapes and very few details; clearly the smallest, plainest basic soldier.
subjects.UNIT:MARTIAN:MARKSMAN: Subject: Ray Gunner, a chunky cute heavy alien gunner with a huge round head and a broad stocky body in a wide braced stance: a smooth bald pale lavender-grey head with two very big glossy black almond eyes, inside a clear round glass bubble helmet with a dark gunmetal visor band across its brow and a tall polished chrome fin crest on top like a 1950s rocket fin, no antenna; a bulky silver-white space suit with dark gunmetal gloves and boots; a big boxy dark gunmetal power pack on his back with one thick coiled black cable looping round to the gun; he holds low at the hip in both hands one very long heavy two-handed silver ray rifle with big fins and ring coils that sticks far out to the right, longer than his body is wide, with a glowing hot magenta emitter tip; simple shapes and very few details; clearly a heavy gunner with a very big gun.
subjects.UNIT:MARTIAN:GUARD: Subject: Shield Projector, a chunky cute broad heavy alien defender, the widest and sturdiest trooper: a smooth bald pale lavender-grey head with two very big glossy black almond eyes, no nose and a tiny mouth, inside a clear round glass bubble helmet with one white highlight and a thick chrome rim; heavy dark gunmetal and silver armour with very big round shoulder plates and thick armoured legs in a wide braced stance; held in front of him in both hands one big round polished chrome energy shield disc that covers his body from chest to knees, with a glowing hot magenta lens at its centre and a thin hot magenta rim, and one faint thin curved magenta arc of energy in front of it; simple shapes and very few details; clearly a defender who holds the line, not a shooter.
subjects.UNIT:MARTIAN:CAPTAIN: Subject: Brain, a chunky cute alien brain in a jar on a walking carrier: one very big wrinkled pale lavender-grey brain with two small glossy black eyes, floating inside a large clear round glass jar dome with one white highlight that takes up the top two thirds of the image, a few small glowing hot magenta sparks around the brain, sitting on a small round polished chrome base with a row of three small hot magenta lights, carried on four short bent dark gunmetal spider legs; simple shapes and very few details; the feet of the legs are the lowest thing in the image.
subjects.UNIT:MARTIAN:RAIDER: Subject: Saucer, a small classic 1950s flying saucer, flying: one wide round polished chrome disc seen slightly from above, a row of small round glowing hot magenta running lights around its rim, a clear pale glass dome on top with one white highlight and the tiny bald lavender-grey head of an alien pilot with big black eyes inside, a dark gunmetal underside with one short round beam emitter glowing hot magenta under its centre; no legs and no landing gear; simple shapes and very few details; clearly a small fast scout ship.
subjects.UNIT:MARTIAN:CATAPULT: Subject: Tripod, a tall three-legged walking war machine: a rounded hooded polished chrome head like a smooth cowl with rivets, with one big round glowing hot magenta eye lens in front, standing high on three long thin jointed dark gunmetal legs with round chrome knee joints and small round feet, and one bent mechanical arm under the head that ends in a heat-ray emitter with a glowing hot magenta tip; tall and narrow; simple shapes and very few details; the three feet are the lowest thing in the image; clearly a walking siege machine, much taller than a soldier.
subjects.UNIT:MARTIAN:KNIGHT: Subject: Mothership, a large grand 1950s flying saucer, flying, clearly the biggest ship of the fleet: a very wide thick polished chrome hull of two stacked decks, one wide disc on top of another, seen slightly from above, each deck with its own ring of round glowing hot magenta lights, a dark armoured gunmetal command dome on top with small chrome fins and a short antenna, no glass bubble and no pilot, and a dark gunmetal underside with one big round open beam port glowing hot magenta under its centre; no legs and no landing gear; simple shapes and very few details; clearly a big heavy command ship, much bigger and grander than a scout saucer.
subjects.UNIT:MARTIAN:JUGGERNAUT: Subject: Colossus, a huge heavy armoured three-legged walking war machine: a massive rounded polished chrome head with thick riveted armour plates, a dark gunmetal visor band with two big round glowing hot magenta eye lenses, a short antenna with a hot magenta tip, standing on three thick sturdy armoured chrome legs with big round dark gunmetal joints and wide flat feet, and one big heavy heat-ray cannon arm with ring coils and a glowing hot magenta muzzle; wide and towering; simple shapes and very few details; the three feet are the lowest thing in the image; clearly a giant war machine, far bigger than any soldier.
subjects.UNIT:MARTIAN:THRALL: Subject: Thrall, a chunky cute mind-controlled soldier with a huge round head about half of the figure's height and a tiny sturdy body, slumped and hunched with drooping shoulders and both arms hanging down: a pale grey blank face with two empty round white eyes and no pupils, a polished chrome control helmet clamped over the top of the head with a short antenna and one glowing hot magenta light on its front, a dark gunmetal collar ring round the neck, a plain drab mid-grey tunic and trousers with no emblem, dark grey boots, a plain dull grey short club hanging low in one hand; simple shapes and very few details; clearly a dazed puppet, not a knight and not an alien.
subjects.PORTRAIT:MARTIAN:FIGHTER: Subject: Grunt portrait, head and shoulders of a small plain cute little alien trooper: a smooth bald pale lavender-grey head with two very big glossy black almond eyes, no nose and a tiny mouth, inside a plain clear round glass dome helmet with one white highlight and one short antenna with a glowing hot magenta tip; the narrow shoulders of a plain light silver-white jumpsuit with a dark gunmetal collar and one small hot magenta chest light, no armour; a small stubby silver ray pistol with a glowing hot magenta muzzle held up beside the head.
subjects.PORTRAIT:MARTIAN:MARKSMAN: Subject: Ray Gunner portrait, head and shoulders of a chunky cute heavy alien gunner: a smooth bald pale lavender-grey head with two very big glossy black almond eyes, inside a clear round glass bubble helmet with a dark gunmetal visor band across its brow and a tall polished chrome fin crest on top, no antenna; bulky silver-white shoulders with the strap of a dark gunmetal power pack and a thick coiled black cable; a long heavy finned silver ray rifle with ring coils and a glowing hot magenta emitter tip held across the chest.
subjects.PORTRAIT:MARTIAN:GUARD: Subject: Shield Projector portrait, head and shoulders of a chunky cute broad heavy alien defender: a smooth bald pale lavender-grey head with two very big glossy black almond eyes, no nose and a tiny mouth, inside a clear round glass bubble helmet with a thick chrome rim; very big round dark gunmetal and silver shoulder plates; the top of a big round polished chrome energy shield disc with a glowing hot magenta lens and a thin hot magenta rim held up in front of the chest.
subjects.PORTRAIT:MARTIAN:CAPTAIN: Subject: Brain, a chunky cute alien brain in a jar, shown whole and large: one very big wrinkled pale lavender-grey brain with two small glossy black eyes floating inside a large clear round glass jar dome with one white highlight, a few small glowing hot magenta sparks, on a small round polished chrome base with three small hot magenta lights; no legs; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.PORTRAIT:MARTIAN:RAIDER: Subject: Saucer, a small classic 1950s flying saucer shown whole: one wide round polished chrome disc with a row of small round glowing hot magenta lights around its rim, a clear pale glass dome on top with one white highlight and the tiny lavender-grey head of an alien pilot with big black eyes inside, a dark gunmetal underside; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.PORTRAIT:MARTIAN:CATAPULT: Subject: Tripod, the head of a three-legged walking war machine shown large: a rounded hooded polished chrome head like a smooth cowl with rivets, one big round glowing hot magenta eye lens in front, the tops of three thin dark gunmetal legs below it and a small heat-ray emitter arm with a glowing hot magenta tip; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.PORTRAIT:MARTIAN:KNIGHT: Subject: Mothership, a large grand 1950s flying saucer shown whole: a very wide thick polished chrome hull of stacked decks, each with its own ring of round glowing hot magenta lights, and a grey armoured command dome on top with a short antenna, no glass bubble; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.PORTRAIT:MARTIAN:JUGGERNAUT: Subject: Colossus, the head of a huge armoured walking war machine shown large: a massive rounded polished chrome head with thick riveted armour plates, a dark gunmetal visor band with two big round glowing hot magenta eye lenses, a short antenna with a hot magenta tip, and the muzzle of a heavy heat-ray cannon with ring coils beside it; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.PORTRAIT:MARTIAN:THRALL: Subject: Thrall portrait, head and shoulders of a chunky cute mind-controlled soldier with drooping shoulders: a pale grey blank face with two empty round white eyes and no pupils, a polished chrome control helmet clamped over the top of the head with a short antenna and one glowing hot magenta light on its front, a dark gunmetal collar ring, a plain drab mid-grey tunic.
subjects.CITY:MARTIAN:1/CALM: Subject: a small level-1 alien colony, the first of three sizes of one colony: one landed flying saucer of polished silver-white chrome standing on three short dark gunmetal landing legs, with a pale glass dome on top and a row of small bright hot magenta lights around its rim, two small round silver-white chrome dome huts with one bright hot magenta round window each pressed against it, and one thin tall silver antenna mast with a small ball on top; no wall, no flag. Buildings only.
subjects.CITY:MARTIAN:2/CALM: Subject: a medium level-2 alien colony, the second of three sizes of one colony: one big landed flying saucer of polished silver-white chrome on three short dark gunmetal landing legs, with a pale glass dome and a row of bright hot magenta lights around its rim, four round silver-white chrome dome buildings of different sizes with bright hot magenta round windows packed tightly around it, joined by short chrome tubes, a low dark gunmetal ring fence, and one thin tall silver antenna mast with a small ball on top; no flag. Buildings only.
subjects.CITY:MARTIAN:3/CALM: Subject: a large level-3 alien colony, the biggest of three sizes of one colony, crowded and grand: one huge landed flying saucer of polished silver-white chrome with a big pale glass dome and a ring of bright hot magenta lights in the middle, surrounded and filled from side to side by many round silver-white chrome dome buildings and two tall chrome towers with pale glass domes and bright hot magenta round windows, joined by chrome tubes, inside a low dark gunmetal ring wall with four small chrome pylons, and one thin very tall silver antenna mast with a small ball on top; no flag. Buildings only.
subjects.ICON:ACTION:BEAM_DOWN: Subject: one small polished chrome flying saucer with a pale glass dome at the top of the image, shining one wide bright hot magenta light beam straight down from its underside, with one small silver-white trooper figure silhouette inside the beam near the bottom and two small pale pink sparkles; nothing else in the image.
subjects.ICON:ACTION:MIND_CONTROL: Subject: one big wrinkled pale lavender-grey brain with three bold curved hot magenta wave arcs radiating from each side of it and one small hot magenta spiral above it; nothing else in the image.
subjects.ICON:ACTION:TRACTOR_BEAM: Subject: one polished chrome flying saucer at the top left of the image shining a slanted cone of bright hot magenta light down to the right, and one small round grey boulder lifted in the air inside the cone with two short pale pink motion lines pointing back toward the saucer; nothing else in the image.
subjects.ICON:ACTION:MARTIAN:RALLY: Subject: one polished chrome antenna dish on a short dark gunmetal stand, pointing up to the right, with three bold curved hot magenta signal arcs spreading out of it and one small pale pink four-pointed star; nothing else in the image.
subjects.ICON:ACTION:FORCE_FIELD: Subject: one short polished chrome emitter pylon with a dark gunmetal base and a small glowing hot magenta ball on top, standing under one big half-dome of thin bright hot magenta energy made of hexagon cells with a pale pink shine; nothing else in the image.
subjects.ICON:STATUS:SHIELD: Subject: one big bold shield shape, a heater shield seen from the front, made of bright hot magenta energy with a pale pink inner shine and a thick dark outline, with one small white highlight in the upper left; flat and simple; nothing else in the image.
subjects.ICON:STATUS:COOLING: Subject: one short chunky polished chrome ray gun barrel with ring coils, pointing to the right, its muzzle dark gunmetal and no longer glowing, with three wavy pale grey heat lines rising straight up from it; nothing else in the image.
subjects.EFFECT:HEAT_RAY: Subject: a round starburst flash of a heat ray hitting: short spiky flame tongues pointing outward in every direction from a round white-hot centre, white in the middle, then pale pink, then bright hot magenta, shaded with dark magenta, with a few small pale pink spark specks around it, floating in empty space; no base, no fire pit, no logs.
subjects.EFFECT:SHIELD_FLARE: Subject: a curved energy shield flaring as it stops a hit: one bold thick arc like a wide crescent bowed to the left, made of hexagon cells, bright hot magenta with a pale pink inner edge and one white flash star at its middle, shaded with dark magenta; floating in empty space; symmetrical top to bottom.
subjects.EFFECT:BEAM_DOWN: Subject: one tall narrow vertical column of light, a teleport beam: a straight pillar slightly wider at the bottom, bright hot magenta at its edges and pale pink to white in its middle, with four small white four-pointed sparkles rising inside it and one flat pale pink ring at its foot; floating in empty space; no saucer, no figure.
subjects.EFFECT:TRACTOR_BEAM: Subject: one cone of light, a tractor beam seen from the side: narrow at the top and widening towards the bottom, bright hot magenta at its edges and pale pink in its middle, crossed by three bold curved white rings one above the other like hoops; floating in empty space; no saucer, no figure.
subjects.EFFECT:MIND_CONTROL: Subject: a hypnosis swirl symbol: one bold spiral line winding three turns outward from its centre, bright hot magenta with a pale pink inner edge, shaded with dark magenta, with two small white four-pointed stars beside it; floating in empty space; round overall.
subjects.UNIT:MARTIAN:PATROL_BOAT: Subject: Patrol Boat of the Martians, a chunky cute small sleek chrome hover-boat seen from the front-right, no mast and no sail: a smooth rounded polished chrome and silver-white saucer-like hull shaded soft blue-grey with a dark gunmetal underside and two small fins, a clear pale glass dome cockpit with one white highlight, a short antenna with a glowing hot magenta tip and a row of small glowing hot magenta running lights along the rim; simple shapes and very few details; retro toy-like 1950s science fiction.
subjects.UNIT:MARTIAN:BATTLESHIP: Subject: Battleship of the Martians, a chunky cute big chrome hover-cruiser seen from the front-right, no mast and no sail: a long rounded polished chrome and silver-white hull shaded soft blue-grey with a dark gunmetal underside and fins, a tall chrome bridge tower under a clear pale glass dome, two chunky chrome ray turrets with glowing hot magenta emitter tips, and small glowing hot magenta running lights; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.UNIT:MARTIAN:EMBARKED_TRANSPORT: Subject: Embarked transport of the Martians, a chunky cute wide low chrome hover-barge seen from the front-right, no mast and no sail: a flat rounded polished chrome hull shaded soft blue-grey with a dark gunmetal underside, a long clear pale glass canopy dome over the cargo with one white highlight, and small glowing hot magenta lights at the bow and stern; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.PORTRAIT:MARTIAN:PATROL_BOAT: Subject: Patrol Boat of the Martians, a chunky cute small chrome hover-boat shown whole from the front-right: a rounded polished chrome hull with a dark gunmetal underside and small fins, a clear glass dome cockpit, glowing hot magenta running lights; no water; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.PORTRAIT:MARTIAN:BATTLESHIP: Subject: Battleship of the Martians, a chunky cute big chrome hover-cruiser shown whole from the front-right: a long chrome hull with a dark gunmetal underside, a bridge tower under a glass dome, chrome ray turrets with glowing hot magenta tips; no water; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.IMPROVEMENT:MARTIAN:WINDMILL: Subject: a solar power collector: three big flat rectangular solar panels of dark navy-blue glass divided into a grid of small square cells by thin silver lines, tilted up toward the sky on slender polished chrome stands, side by side in a row, each on short dark gunmetal feet, with one short chrome mast between them topped by one small hot magenta pink light; wide and low, like a toy. Machine only.
subjects.IMPROVEMENT:MARTIAN:FARM: Subject: a small hydroponic farm: three straight horizontal troughs of polished silver chrome, one above the other, each running from the left edge to the right edge of the image, with clear empty transparent gaps between the troughs; in each trough grows one row of five round leafy green vegetables side by side, each under its own small clear pale glass dome with one white highlight. Troughs, plants and domes only.
subjects.UNIT:MARTIAN:SUBMARINE: Subject: Submarine of the Martians, a chunky cute small chrome bathysphere seen from the front-right, no mast and no sail: one round ball-shaped polished chrome and silver-white hull shaded soft blue-grey with a dark gunmetal underside, a big clear pale glass dome on top with one white highlight, one large round glass porthole on its side, two small fins, a short antenna with a glowing hot magenta tip, and a row of small glowing hot magenta lights around its middle; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.PORTRAIT:MARTIAN:SUBMARINE: Subject: Submarine of the Martians, a chunky cute small chrome bathysphere shown whole from the front-right: a round ball-shaped polished chrome hull with a dark gunmetal underside, a big clear glass dome on top, one large round glass porthole, two small fins, a row of glowing hot magenta lights around its middle; no mast, no sail, no water; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.UNIT:MARTIAN:SWORDSMAN: Subject: Shock Trooper, a chunky cute squat heavy alien brawler sealed in a battle-suit, the faction's only close fighter: a smooth bald pale lavender-grey head with two very big glossy black almond eyes inside a clear round glass dome helmet with one white highlight and a thick chrome collar; a wide round polished chrome battle-suit like a barrel, shaded soft blue-grey, with two big round chrome shoulder domes and dark gunmetal joints, short thick armoured legs in a wide stance; one arm ends in a huge heavy chrome pincer claw held forward, the other in a big chrome fist; a few thin jagged hot magenta lightning arcs crackle over the shoulder domes and the pincer, and one small hot magenta chest light; no pistol, no gun and no shield; simple shapes and very few details; clearly a heavy brawler who shocks what touches him, neither the slim Grunt with his pistol nor the Shield Projector behind his disc.
subjects.PORTRAIT:MARTIAN:SWORDSMAN: Subject: Shock Trooper portrait, head and shoulders of a chunky cute heavy alien brawler: a smooth bald pale lavender-grey head with two very big glossy black almond eyes, no nose and a tiny mouth, inside a clear round glass dome helmet with one white highlight and one short antenna with a glowing hot magenta tip; very big round polished chrome shoulder plates of a heavy battle-suit, with thin jagged hot magenta lightning arcs crackling over the dome and the shoulder plates; one heavy chrome pincer claw raised beside the head; no pistol.
subjects.IMPROVEMENT:MARTIAN:LUMBER_CAMP: Subject: an alien harvester camp: at the back two tall fungal stalks of dusty orange-brown ochre (#b06a48, shade #7f4634, never red) with rounded teal caps (#3f9c93); in front a neat stack of cut ochre stalk logs showing pale round ends, one cut stalk stump, and a small silver-white chrome harvester pod on three short gunmetal legs with a glass dome and one hot magenta cutting beam pointing at the stump. Chrome, gunmetal, ochre, teal, a little magenta; no wood, no green, no red. Compact, with an empty margin all round.
subjects.IMPROVEMENT:MARTIAN:SAWMILL: Subject: an alien laser sawmill, no stalks standing: one low round silver-white chrome dome hut with a round hot magenta window and a small antenna; at its front one big round chrome saw disc with a glowing hot magenta edge standing upright in a gunmetal bench, a stalk log lying on the bench; beside it a stack of three stalk logs with pale round ends. The logs are a dusty orange-brown ochre (#b06a48, shade #7f4634), never red. Chrome, gunmetal, ochre, magenta; no wood, no green. Compact, with an empty margin all round.
